_style_prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration like a hand-made paper-cut animated documentary: bold simple geometric shapes with clean dark-brown outlines, visible soft paper grain and faint hand-drawn crackle lines, evenly lit bright mid-tone warm colors (NOT dark, NOT night), muted earthy palette of terracotta red, ochre, cream, sage green and black ink, characters drawn front-facing and symmetrical with minimal faces made of a few simple lines, flat colors with slight soft shading, gentle vignette, a few simple pale flowers scattered as decoration. Wide 16:9, no text, no letters.
